title: Indonesia's constitution says the president may not freeze or dissolve the House of Representatives
summary: Indonesia's constitution says the president may not freeze or dissolve the House of Representatives.
body: Article 7C says the president may not freeze and/or dissolve the DPR, the House of Representatives. The source says: "Article 7C The President may not freeze and/or dissolve the DPR." The prohibition is specific. A different article allows the president to declare a state of emergency, with conditions and subsequent measures regulated by law.
